matches.title: Task Group: 代号柒 搜打撤 Vite workflow tooling, lean process, and review fixes
matches.excerpt:
150: 
151: - Workflow entrypoints are `docs/WORKFLOW-TOOLS.md`, `scripts/workflow.mjs`, `workflow-ledger.mjs`, `workflow-evidence.mjs`, and `workflow-archive.mjs`. Archive originals at `docs/archive/<batch>/originals/` with a manifest before source removal. [Task 1]
152: - 2026-10-05 current override: ordinary small fixes need no task.json; requested delegation/cross-chat tracking uses `docs/evidence/<date>-<task>/task.json`. Current project docs govern the condition. STATUS is a delivery log; receipts invalidate on relevant inputs/environment changes. [Task 1; current user-directed efficiency iteration]
153: - For named project history, `npm run --silent workflow -- memory --source codex --query "<keywords>" --limit 3 --json` reads its index before bounded current-repository excerpts; source zcode/both selects other-platform experience. No query retains discovery-only behavior; historical dispatch is not new delegation authority. [2026-10-05 current user-directed dual-platform iteration]
154: - `skip` means not executed, never passed. For a direct contract script, map to a direct test; unknown scripts or state/storage/save boundaries select full validation. `acceptance-gate.mjs` treats `battle/core` and `battle/runtime` as full-gate paths. [Task 1][Task 2]
155: - `workflow-staged.mjs` needs real snapshot integration tests: isolated Git metadata/index plus CLI-only tests can miss contamination of source/target index. Preserve the source and target index and clean temporary state. Static dependency analysis may narrow scope only for known static imports; dynamic/unknown file
